<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">（<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="23012002" href="/cmn-hans/%E5%A4%9A%E5%AA%92%E4%BD%93%E5%9B%BE%E4%B9%A6%E9%A6%86/%E5%9C%A3%E7%BB%8F/%E7%B2%BE%E8%AF%BB%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%A3%E7%BB%8F/%E5%9C%A3%E7%BB%8F%E5%8D%B7%E7%9B%AE/%E4%BB%A5%E8%B5%9B%E4%BA%9A%E4%B9%A6/12/#v23012002" target="_blank"><ruby><rb>以赛亚书</rb><rt>Yǐsàiyàshū</rt></ruby>12:2</a>）</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1．</span><ruby><rb>耶和华</rb><rt>Yēhéhuá</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>上帝</rb><rt>Shàngdì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>我们</rb><rt>wǒmen</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>的</rb><rt>de</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>力量</rb><rt>lìliang</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz"><ruby><rb>施行</rb><rt>Shīxíng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>拯救</rb><rt>zhěngjiù</rt></ruby>，<ruby><rb>我们</rb><rt>wǒmen</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>欢呼</rb><rt>huānhū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>颂扬</rb><rt>sòngyáng</rt></ruby>。</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp"><ruby><rb>愿</rb><rt>Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>为</rb><rt>wèi</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>你</rb><rt>nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>作见证</rb><rt>zuò-jiànzhèng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>传</rb><rt>chuán</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>好消息</rb><rt>hǎo xiāoxi</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz"><ruby><rb>不论</rb><rt>Búlùn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>人</rb><rt>rén</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>接受</rb><rt>jiēshòu</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>或</rb><rt>huò</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>拒绝</rb><rt>jùjué</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>聆听</rb><rt>língtīng</rt></ruby>。</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 se">（<ruby><rb>副歌</rb><rt>Fùgē</rt></ruby>）</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp"><ruby><rb>耶和华</rb><rt>Yēhéhuá</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>上帝</rb><rt>Shàngdì</rt></ruby>，<ruby><rb>我们</rb><rt>wǒmen</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>的</rb><rt>de</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>力量</rb><rt>lìliang</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sz"><ruby><rb>愿</rb><rt>Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>将</rb><rt>jiāng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>你</rb><rt>nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>圣名</rb><rt>shèngmíng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>昼夜</rb><rt>zhòuyè</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>宣扬</rb><rt>xuānyáng</rt></ruby>。</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sp"><ruby><rb>荣耀</rb><rt>Róngyào</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>的</rb><rt>de</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>上帝</rb><rt>Shàngdì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>你</rb><rt>nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>伟大</rb><rt>wěidà</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>全能</rb><rt>quánnéng</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sz"><ruby><rb>我们</rb><rt>Wǒmen</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>的</rb><rt>de</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>庇护所</rb><rt>bìhùsuǒ</rt></ruby>、<ruby><rb>坚强</rb><rt>jiānqiáng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>后盾</rb><rt>hòudùn</rt></ruby>。</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
